items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: it was back in the Thirties, the early Thirties, about '31 or '32, Billy Hicks, Joe Vidas(?), Quinton Harrington and...

ctx.x: Sandy Williams... I can remember. Jack Butler, Bob Carroll. Manzie Johnson on drums. Rupert Coles, Honi Coles' father. Quinton Harrington...
I don't know him. What did he play?
